mentions.name: Flexito
mentions.description: Flexito is a website and mobile app (PWA) for daily stretching and mobility exercises, offering about 100 routines users can pick from or build their own from existing exercises. Each routine includes simple images, a YouTube video link, and a timer, with many 5-minute routines suited to short breaks during work. It requires no accounts.
mentions.problem: The builder sits too much during the day and wants to stretch more often and strengthen back/core muscles; existing free apps like Bend had ads and limitations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've built Flexito, a website/mobile app (it's PWA) for daily stretching and mobility exercises.

As many of us here, I sit too much in my chair during the day and I'm trying to stretch more often and strengthen my back/core muscles.
